# affected consumer surface

The projection consumer surfaces that a myth tends to leak into — e.g. Wikipedia, public site, agent memory — so that a correction can be scoped to the surfaces that actually carry the bad claim. Reuses the gmeow:ProjectionContext vocabulary (#225).
